use default

let sieve_limit = 10_000_000
let composite = LIST(sieve_limit)

for _ in 0..sieve_limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

for candidate in 2..sieve_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= sieve_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple < sieve_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

is_prime(value: long) -> bool is
    if value < cast(sieve_limit) then
        return value >= 2L /\ !composite[cast(value)]
    fi

    let divisor mut = 2L

    while divisor * divisor <= value do
        if value % divisor == 0L then
            return false
        fi
        divisor = divisor + 1L
    od

    return true
si

zero_free(digits: int) -> Pipe[long] is
    if digits == 0 then
        yield 0L
        return
    fi

    for shorter in zero_free(digits - 1) do
        for digit in 1::9 do
            yield shorter * 10L + cast(digit)
        od
    od
si

cyclops() -> Pipe[long] is
    let half mut = 0

    while true do
        let scale = (0..half) |> reduce(1L, (acc, _) => acc * 10L)

        for left in zero_free(half) do
            for right in zero_free(half) do
                yield (left * 10L + 0L) * scale + right
            od
        od

        half = half + 1
    od
si

blinded(value: long) -> long is
    let text = "{value}"
    let middle = text.length / 2

    return long.parse("{text[0..middle]}{text[middle + 1..<0]}")
si

is_palindrome(value: long) -> bool is
    let text = "{value}"

    return (0..text.length / 2)
        |> all(i => text[i] == text[text.length - 1 - i])
si

report(name: string, numbers: () -> Pipe[long]) is
    write_line("first 50 {name}:")

    let first_50 = numbers() |> take(50) |> collect_list()

    for row in 0..5 do
        let cells = (0..10)
            |> map(column => "{first_50[row * 10 + column],10}")

        write_line(cells |> join(""))
    od

    let beyond = numbers()
        |> index()
        |> find((position, value) => value > 10_000_000L)

    if let (position, value) = beyond then
        write_line("first over ten million: {value}")
        write_line("  at position {position + 1}")
    fi

    write_line("")
si

report("cyclops numbers", () => cyclops())
report("prime cyclops numbers", () => cyclops() |> filter(is_prime))
report("blind prime cyclops numbers",
       () => cyclops()
           |> filter(is_prime)
           |> filter(c => is_prime(blinded(c))))
report("palindromic prime cyclops numbers",
       () => cyclops() |> filter(is_palindrome) |> filter(is_prime))
